info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, survivorDelay, thisMember, startMember, Xvel, cableGuy, survivorState, ThisWidth, thisHalfHeight, grabCount, distToHQ, frameDir, pullCount, loopX, loopWidth, COPTER, lump, snowBlow, lumpHeightglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gCableItem, gCableLength, gRescueCount, gRescuedList, gScore, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  startMember = this.memberNum  lump = sprite(the currentSpriteNum - 1)  lumpHeight = lump.height  thisMember = random(3) + startMember - 1  COPTER = sprite(4)  snowBlow = sprite(56)  this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 60  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256 - 64  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  survivorState = #ONGROUND  ThisWidth = this.width  thisHalfHeight = this.height / 2  grabCount = 0  distToHQ = 0  frameDir = 1  pullCount = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case survivorState of      #ONGROUND:        Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        lump.loc = this.loc + point(0, 11)        survivorDelay = survivorDelay + 1        if survivorDelay >= 5 then          survivorDelay = 0          if ((thisMember + frameDir) > (startMember + 2)) or ((thisMember + frameDir) < startMember) then            frameDir = -frameDir          end if          thisMember = thisMember + frameDir          this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        end if        diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)        if (diffX < 70) and (diffY < 100) then          if lump.height > 6 then            lumpHeight = lumpHeight - 0.25            lump.height = lumpHeight            if lumpHeight = (6 + 0.25) then              puppetSound(4, member(9, "Sfx"))            end if            snowBlow.loc = this.loc + point(0, -12)          else            if (diffX < ThisWidth) and (diffY < thisHalfHeight) then              grabCount = grabCount + 1              if grabCount >= 2 then                if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then                  survivorState = #GRABBED                  gCableItem = 1                end if              end if            else              grabCount = 0            end if          end if        end if      #GRABBED:        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset        if Xpos > loopX then          Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        lump.locH = this.locH        survivorDelay = survivorDelay + 1        if survivorDelay >= 5 then          survivorDelay = 0          if ((thisMember + frameDir) > (startMember + 2)) or ((thisMember + frameDir) < startMember) then            frameDir = -frameDir          end if          thisMember = thisMember + frameDir          this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        end if        if soundBusy(4) = 0 then          puppetSound(4, member(39, "Sfx"))        end if        xDiff = float(COPTER.locH - gXVel - this.locH)        yDiff = float(COPTER.locV + COPTER.Yvel - this.locV)        distToCopter = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        toCopterVector = this.loc - COPTER.loc + point(-gXVel, COPTER.Yvel)        if distToCopter > gCableLength then          pullVector = toCopterVector / float(distToCopter) * (distToCopter - gCableLength)          gXVelChange = gXVelChange - pullVector.locH          COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel + pullVector.locV          cableGuy.cableState = #GODOWN          if pullVector.locV > 0 then            Ypos = Ypos - 0.10000000000000001            pullCount = pullCount + 1          end if        end if        toCableGuyVector = this.loc - (cableGuy.loc + point(cableGuy.Xvel, cableGuy.Yvel))        pullVector = toCableGuyVector        cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel + pullVector.locH        cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel + pullVector.locV        if pullCount > 40 then          survivorState = #ONCABLE          puppetSound(4, member(63 + cableGuy.speechCounter, "Sfx"))        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          survivorState = #INCOPTER          gScore = gScore + 500          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          gRescuedList.add(this)          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1        end if      #INCOPTER:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #GOTOHQ:        thisMember = thisMember + 1        if thisMember > (startMember + 2) then          thisMember = startMember        end if        this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        if distToHQ <= 0 then          Xvel = 0          this.blend = this.blend - 5          if this.blend <= 0 then            survivorState = #HOME            gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1            gScore = gScore + 1000            puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          end if        end if        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel        distToHQ = distToHQ + Xvel        Ypos = 270        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos      #HOME:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000    end case  end ifend
